liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Days Between** (3 reviews): Days Between is described as extra spacey and right on; Jerry nearly stumbles but recovers for an emotional close, then plays a beautiful short instrumental coda [6][7][12]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Jerry seems merely along for the ride in the Scarlet-Fire pairing, a weak second-set opener; Reviewer finds the Scarlet-Fire mediocre, likening it to day-old pizza [5][7]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): Reviewer says the opener got the night off to a great, energetic start [3]
- **Saint Of Circumstance** (1 review): Saint of Circumstance gets Jerry into gear enough to coast through Lazy River Road and Corrina into drums [5]
- **Lazy River Road** (1 review): Reviewer singles out a nice Lazy River Road [12]
- **Corrina** (1 review): Reviewer calls Corrina smokin' [6]
- **Around And Around** (1 review): A voice at the start of the tape seems to call for Around and Around, which closes set two [12]

## The recordings

- **gd94-04-08.schoeps.ladner.10503.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 155 min; rated 3.55/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording's sound quality excellent [3]
- **gd1994-04-08.139358.sbd.set2.ebel.flac1644**: soundboard; 11 songs; 105 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer feels Jerry seemed eager to finish and get back to the hotel [4]
- Jerry's tuning-up warm-up at the start is described as a gem in itself [5]
- Jerry has a few lyrical flubs but sings and plays amazingly well [8]
- Security searched people entering, but nobody was checking or tearing tickets at the door [11]
- Reviewer points to the 21 February 1992 show as a related comparison [4]
- Reviewer rates it 3 stars, saying it would be lower in any year other than 1994 [7]
- Reviewer says spring 1994 is worth exploring and has never heard a version quite like this one [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-04-08.schoeps.ladner.10503.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Chris L.; source: Audience: Schoeps CMC521's [1]. Also: Audience recording with Schoeps CMC521 microphones, to DAT, then CDR, via Paul; seeded to etree by Chris L [1]
- **gd1994-04-08.139358.sbd.set2.ebel.flac1644**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: Soundboard->Cassette->DAT [2]. Also: The soundboard set two cut the encore I Fought The Law, so a Schoeps CMC 521 front-of-board audience DAT filled it [2]
